# Rent & Radiate

> A marketplace to rent, buy and sell designer dresses, jewellery and fashion from verified boutiques near you.

Rent & Radiate connects shoppers with hand-picked local boutiques and jewellers.
Rent an outfit for a day or a wedding, or buy it outright — with refundable
deposits, verified sellers, transparent pricing and tracked delivery.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured stores, trending rentals and new arrivals.
- [Browse](/browse): Search and filter dresses, jewellery and accessories to rent or buy.
- [How it works](/how-it-works): Rental process, deposits, delivery and trust & safety.
- [About](/about): Our story and what the marketplace stands for.
- [Advertise](/advertise): Advertising packages for brands and boutiques.
- [Become a seller](/become-vendor): How boutiques list and rent out their collections.
- [Help](/help): Answers to common questions about orders, returns and refunds.
- [Contact](/contact): Ways to reach the support team.

## Optional

- [Terms & conditions](/terms): Rules for renting, buying and selling.
- [Privacy policy](/privacy): How personal data is collected and used.
